title: A more polished Tabby
body:
# A more polished Tabby

**Version:** 1.7.0
**Release Date:** 2026-10-25

Drag and drop, richer themes, smoother keyboard navigation, and smarter search.

## What's New

### Put tabs where you want them

Drag tabs, selections, and whole groups to reorder them or move them between windows. Clear feedback helps you see what you're moving and where it can go.

### Follow your moved tabs

Moving tabs to another window brings that window and its Tab Manager forward, ready to continue where you left off.

### Coordinated color themes

Choose from fifteen complete looks, from calm neutrals with subtle headers to combinations of coral, mint, plum, lavender, and gold. Each brings matching backgrounds, controls, and selections to light and dark mode, so Tabby feels more personal with a single choice.

New installs and extension updates start with Porcelain, following your system’s light or dark mode. Choose another theme in Options at any time.

### Simpler, easier-to-read options

Larger text and clearer headings make Options easier to scan. Tonal themes appear first, with simpler previews to help you choose a look. Preferences are changed individually, keeping your other choices intact.

### Clearer tab groups

Tab groups keep a single color bar, making their color easier to recognize when you switch tabs.

### Smoother keyboard navigation

Move naturally between tabs, groups, windows, and window editing with more consistent keyboard controls.

### Keep your place after closing a tab

Keep working with the keyboard after closing a tab. Focus follows the new active tab, or stays beside the tab you closed when it was inactive.

### Close tabs with a middle click

Middle-click a tab in the Tab Manager to close it without switching to it or changing your selection of other tabs.

### Add a tab where you need it

Create a new tab directly below an existing tab, keeping it in the same group when applicable.

### Search that remembers your choices

Repeat a search to bring the destinations you recently chose toward the top, whether they are commands, windows, tab groups, or pages. Better result ordering helps you work through similar tabs, and keyboard selection stays on the same result as more matches arrive.

title: Named windows and a simpler Tab Manager
body:
# Named windows and a simpler Tab Manager

**Version:** 1.6.0
**Release Date:** 2026-10-17

## What's New

### Name your windows

Give each window a custom name, icon, and color so it's easy to recognize. Names appear in search and when moving tabs between windows. Search for a window by name to switch straight to it.

### One window, one clear view

The Tab Manager now shows one window at a time in a single pane, giving your tabs more room. Switch, create, and close windows from the new header.

### Stay in context

Choosing a window now brings it forward and opens its Tab Manager. Clicking a tab switches to it, keeping the sidebar in sync with what you're viewing.

### Improved keyboard controls

Move between the window header, tabs, and tools with the arrow keys.

title: Seasonal icons
body:
# Seasonal icons

**Version:** 1.5.0
**Release Date:** 2026-10-15

## What's New

### Choose seasonal icons

Choose an icon for each seasonal occasion, disable any individual occasion, or turn seasonal icons off entirely. Tabby shows each selected icon during its seasonal window.

### See seasonal icons across Tabby

During its seasonal window, the selected icon appears on Tabby's toolbar and in the Options page header.

### Choose Easter calendar and Thanksgiving region

Choose Western or Orthodox Easter, or use the browser region. Set Thanksgiving to your browser region, the United States, or Canada.

### More room in the sidebar

The "Scroll to active" button has been removed from the sidebar, leaving more room for windows. Search and Settings remain together, and automatic scrolling to the active tab continues when needed.

title: Clearer controls and safer navigation
body:
# Clearer controls and safer navigation

**Version:** 1.4.0
**Release date:** 2026-10-14

This release makes it easier to select tabs across windows, clear duplicate pages, and get around with the keyboard. Large tab sessions feel more responsive, and routine actions finish quietly.

## What's New

### Select tabs without switching pages

Click a tab row to select it without leaving the page you're on. When you're ready to go to a tab, click its icon, double-click the row, or press Enter.

### Keep your selection across windows

Browse other windows in the tab manager while keeping your selected tabs. Select a window or group, then deselect individual tabs while keeping the rest selected. Press Escape to clear the full selection.

### Duplicate tab cleanup

Close duplicate tabs across all windows from a tab's action menu, while keeping the tab you chose.

### Keyboard navigation

Jump between parts of the tab manager with Tab, and use arrow keys to reach **New tab** and **New window**. In narrow panels, the sidebar moves out of the way when you navigate into the tab list.

### Shortcut help

Options now includes a guide to Tab manager keyboard shortcuts, so you can find the keys for navigation, selection, and organization in one place.

### Accessible search and settings

Screen readers announce search results and the selected item. Settings menus follow your preference for reduced animation.

### Responsive large tab sessions

Large tab lists stay responsive as you scroll, navigate, and update tabs. Large groups expand and collapse promptly, and search stays responsive as you type.

### Quieter action feedback

Routine tab actions finish quietly, so you can keep organizing without extra messages interrupting you.

### Reliable shortcuts and search

Chrome shortcuts open search and the tab manager in the window you triggered them from. Search explains when a destination cannot be opened and keeps your query so you can try again.

### Sharper Tabby icons

Tabby's icons stay sharp in Chrome's toolbar and extension list.

title: Batch Actions and Smarter Search
body:
# Batch Actions and Smarter Search

**Version:** 1.3.0
**Release Date:** 2026-10-08

This release makes it easier to work across tabs, groups, and windows. Select multiple items and apply actions to the full selection from a shared menu. Tabby Search now works more consistently across pages and adds new ways to open copies of open tabs and switch between windows.

## What's New

### Batch Actions

Select multiple tabs, groups, or windows, then perform actions across the selection from one shared menu.

### Search in the Extension Popup

Tabby Search now opens in Chrome's standard extension popup from the toolbar or keyboard shortcut. This fixes inconsistent focus across pages and reduces the permissions Tabby needs.

### Open Tabs from Search

Search Chrome tab groups by name. From Tabby Search, hold Cmd/Ctrl to open a copy of an already-open tab in a new tab, or Shift to open a copy in a new window.

### Chrome Window Shortcuts

Assign Chrome shortcuts to focus any of your first ten windows, or search by number in Tabby Search.

### Manual Tab Discard

Discard eligible inactive tabs from a selection in one action, with an action count that reflects eligible tabs and confirmation that reports successful discards. Chrome reloads a discarded tab when you activate it again.

### Keyboard Reordering

Move focused tabs and groups with Alt+Up/Down.

### Create Tabs and Windows

Create and focus tabs in the viewed window or a tab group, and open new windows from the window list.

### Sidebar Layout

In narrow panels, the expanded sidebar overlays the tab pane and action bar without showing content through it.

### Window Identification

Choose whether window names and icons in the Tab Manager and move menus come from the active or first tab.

### Tab Status and Shortcut Details

See loading, pinned, discarded, audible, duplicate, and recently accessed states in the Tab Manager. Its quick action also shows the active Chrome shortcut.

- Subtly tinted confirmations fill the action bar; hover to pause and expand the stack for reading or copying, and use each X to dismiss one message.

title: Tab Manager Redesign and Personalization
body:
**Version:** 1.2.0
**Release Date:** December 17, 2024

This release transforms Tabby with full theming support and a completely redesigned Tab Manager. Personalize every part of the interface with your choice of colors and appearance, navigate faster with keyboard shortcuts, and enjoy a cleaner, more streamlined experience throughout.

## What's New

### Personalize Your Theme

Make Tabby yours with flexible theming options across the entire app. Pick your preferred mode (System, Light, or Dark), choose from over 15 accent colors, and adjust how subtle or bold you want the highlights. Your theme preferences apply everywhere—Omnibar, Tab Manager, and Options all share your customized look. Colors adapt automatically between light and dark mode with separate preferences for each.

### Redesigned Tab Manager

A completely new Tab Manager built for speed and clarity. Navigate your tabs and windows without reaching for the mouse—arrow keys move between items instantly, keeping your focus centered. The new compact sidebar shows all your windows at a glance with tab counts and quick actions. Choose between icon-only or list layouts to match how you work.

### Smarter Search Results

Omnibar now prioritizes recently accessed items, so tabs you opened minutes ago appear near the top instead of being buried below results from weeks ago. Finding what you just looked at is now much more reliable.

### Cleaner Settings

The Options page is now easier to scan with compact dropdowns and better spacing. Tab Manager preferences have their own dedicated section. If you ever want to start fresh, the new Reset button clears all preferences instantly.

### Privacy

The Omnibar popup no longer shows up in your Recently Closed list when you close it with `Cmd+W` or `Ctrl+W`.

title: Polishing the Experience
body:
**Version:** 1.1.0
**Release Date:** 2025-12-04

## Highlights

- **Faster, clearer searches**: Search results are smarter and easier to scan thanks to improved ranking, highlighted matches, and clearer type labels.
- **Better discoverability**: New quick actions and commands make it easier to find and open the features you need (e.g., Tab Manager, Options, theme toggle).
- **Polished UI across the extension**: Visual improvements (spacing, contrast, higher‑quality favicons, and custom scrollbars) make Tabby feel more modern and reliable.

## Omnibar — Find what you need, faster

- Quick Actions & Empty State: When the Omnibar is empty you’ll see contextual actions (like "Open Tab Manager") and tips to discover shortcuts and features without hunting through menus.
- Smarter Results: Results are now ranked by relevance, type, and recency so the items you want appear near the top.
- Improved Scanability: Search terms are highlighted and each result shows a clear, color-coded type label (Tab, Bookmark, History, etc.), plus URLs for bookmark/history items so you know where a link will go.
- Recently Closed & Access Time: Restore recently closed tabs directly from the Omnibar and see when items were last accessed.
- New Commands: Added quick commands for Password Manager, Clear Browsing Data, toggling themes, and opening the Options page.

## Tab Manager — smoother interactions

- Header shortcuts: A new search button in the Tab Manager header opens the Omnibar (hover shows the shortcut). An Options button gives one-click access to preferences.
- UI fixes: Removed accidental debug labels from tab titles and fixed layout issues that could occur with nested buttons.

## Options Page — simpler configuration

- Redesigned layout: Cleaner, easier-to-scan settings and a persistent theme toggle for quick light/dark switching.
- Shortcut guidance: A direct link to Chrome’s shortcut settings and recommended shortcuts to get you started quickly.
- Side panel placement: Instructions to move the Tab Manager to the left or right side of the browser.

## UI & Visual polish

- Custom, auto-hiding scrollbars for a cleaner look across platforms.
- Retina-ready favicons (2x) for crisp icons on high-density displays.
- Improved spacing, iconography, typography and light-theme contrast to reduce visual noise and improve readability.

## Bug fixes & compatibility

- Windows shortcuts: Adjusted default Windows shortcuts to avoid conflicts with Chrome (now using `Alt+E`, `Alt+K`, and `Alt+Shift+E`).
- Omnibar navigation: Fixed issues where the mouse cursor could interfere with keyboard navigation and where ESC wouldn't reliably close the Omnibar.
- Search behavior: Tab and command search now accepts multiple terms (any order), matching history and bookmark search behavior.
- Layout and interaction fixes: Resolved display issues in the Tab Manager and fixed an error caused by nested header buttons.

title: The Launch
body:
**Version:** 1.0.0
**Published Date:** 2025-11-24

**Tabby is here!**
We are thrilled to introduce Tabby, your new browser experience. Tabby transforms how you navigate Chrome, turning your browser into a keyboard-centric command line for maximum productivity.

## What's New

### The Omnibar (Cmd+E / Ctrl+E)

Stop hunting for tabs. Press one shortcut to instantly search everything:

- **Universal Search**: Find any open tab, bookmark, or history item in milliseconds.
- **Web Search**: Type your query and jump straight to Google results.
- **Commands**: Run browser actions like opening Settings or managing extensions without touching your mouse.

### Tab Manager (Cmd+Shift+E / Ctrl+Shift+E)

Bring order to the chaos. Our new side panel gives you a bird's-eye view of your browsing session:

- **Multi-Window Support**: See all your open windows in one clean list.
- **Tab Groups**: Visualize and organize your tab groups effortlessly.
- **Fast Switching**: Jump between tabs and windows with a click.

### Privacy First

We built Tabby with a "Privacy by Design" philosophy:

- **Zero Data Collection**: Tabby runs 100% locally on your device. No data is ever sent to our servers.
- **On-Demand Access**: We only access your current tab when you explicitly ask us to.
- **Sandboxed UI**: Your search queries are isolated in a secure environment, keeping your history safe from prying eyes.

### Bug Fixes

- **Shortcut Bindings**: Fixed the default shortcut bindings to use Windows keys for non-Mac users. **(v1.0.1 2025-11-29)**
